desktopOnly.title: Desktop only
desktopOnly.description: Review capacity settings are available in the OpenBitFun desktop app. Review is not available on this surface.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: Choose whether additional Review work runs one or two at a time, and how long it may wait for provider capacity.

maxParallelReviewers.label: Review parallelism
maxParallelReviewers.description: Controls whether additional review work runs one or two at a time. It changes concurrency, not review scope.

maxQueueWaitSeconds.label: Capacity wait window
maxQueueWaitSeconds.description: How long optional work may wait for provider capacity. Already running checks can make the total review take longer.
